title: Strengthen Solana wallet cleaning and quality evidence
objective: Separate holder exclusion from wallet-quality labelling, suppress known service funders from same-source cluster inference with retained evidence, and expose the resulting wallet and cluster evidence in the CA result.
forbidden_actions: Do not lower the high-confidence cluster exclusion threshold or change the real-holder rule without a separate Owner decision.
Do not exclude a holder because it is bot-like, blacklisted, newly created or supplied by a third-party label.
Do not discard source, confidence, reason or scope for service-funder suppression and wallet-quality evidence.
Do not call external providers, use credentials, activate BSC or Robinhood, or modify the holder snapshot service.
